description: Family Play Therapy combines play-based methods with family therapy principles so children can communicate through play while caregivers practice new ways of responding. Sessions use structured activities (games, art, storytelling, role-play, sand tray) to surface patterns, build empathy, and strengthen the parent-child relationship. It is most useful when a child’s feelings or behavior show up in family interactions, and it is not a substitute for emergency care or intensive treatment when safety is at risk.

sections.content: Family Play Therapy combines play-based methods with family therapy principles so children can communicate through play while caregivers practice new ways of responding. Sessions use structured activities (games, art, storytelling, role-play, sand tray) to surface patterns, build empathy, and strengthen the parent-child relationship. It is most useful when a child’s feelings or behavior show up in family interactions, and it is not a substitute for emergency care or intensive treatment when safety is at risk.
